title: Source-free proof: whole-word rank-difference triple-residue capacity
timing: Inverse/interior reasoning was delivered earlier by message. File finalization overlapped the root run; root announced completion before final registry retention. Do not call this a pre-count file or an outcome-blind registration. No empirical artifact was opened, no source or target was counted, and the mathematical rule was not adapted to the communicated outcome.
contract: For each fixed book, exact whole-token Unicode-sorted W, V>=1, rank range0..V-1. One anchor a is shared by all source paragraphs. Emit one fixed nonempty codeword C[d] per d=(current rank-previous rank) modV; C is injective. Reset only at declared paragraph boundaries. Whole codeword identities and boundaries are preserved.
inverse: Reader starts at a, obtains d via the unique C inverse, and adds it modulo V. This returns the next source rank. Induction reconstructs every supported token sequence and its declared paragraph scope.

interior_lemma.statement: Three equal consecutive output groups beginning at a position with an actual preceding source word imply four consecutive source ranks in arithmetic progression modulo V.
interior_lemma.proof: Injectivity gives the same residue d for all three groups. If the preceding rank is r, the three subsequent ranks are r+d,r+2d,r+3d modV. Conversely such a rank quadruple produces three equal C[d]groups, irrespective of the paragraph anchor.
interior_lemma.scope: All four source ranks belong to the same reset segment. Overlapping quadruples are permitted but repeated occurrences of the same d do not create extra residue types.

initial_lemma.statement: For the first three ranks r1,r2,r3of a paragraph, an initial equal triple exists precisely when r2-r1=r3-r2=d modV and a=r1-d modV.
initial_lemma.proof: The second and third output differences require the stated common d. Equality of the first difference then requires r1-a=d, which fixes a uniquely modulo V. The converse follows by substitution.
initial_lemma.scope: The start anchor is not a fourth written word. A three-word paragraph can have an initial triple even though it has no source quadruple.

capacity_theorem.definitions: D is the set of differences d of all consecutive four-rank progressions wholly within source paragraphs. I_a is the set of differences of qualifying initial three-rank progressions whose uniquely required anchor is a.
capacity_theorem.exact_residue_inventory: For one fixed anchor a, the set of all residues producing at least one equal output triple is exactly D union I_a: every triple is either initial or has an actual preceding word, and the two lemmas characterize those two cases.
capacity_theorem.shared_anchor_maximum: The maximum possible triple-residue type count over the candidate's one shared anchor is B=max_(a in Z/VZ) |D union I_a|. This is exact for that marginal statistic, but only a necessary capacity bound for a complete text correspondence.
capacity_theorem.finite_anchor_reduction: Anchors not required by any initial progression have I_a empty. Therefore B=max(|D|,max_over_recorded_initial_anchors |D union I_a|). This is a mathematical reduction, not a code or source census.
capacity_theorem.target_requirement: Distinct identical-triple whole forms X_j must be different C[d_j]and therefore require distinct residues. Root's inherited four distinct common GDT857forms imply the necessary B>=4. This review makes no new manuscript observation or source count.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not union I_a over different anchors: that would admit independent paragraph starts instead of one shared anchor.
Do not count progressions, paragraphs or windows instead of distinct residue values.
Do not count D and I_a twice when they contain the same d.
Do not require d!=0, four distinct ranks, monotone integer ranks or absence of modular wraparound.
Do not join source paragraphs to manufacture a quadruple or pool different books' moduli and dictionaries.

readability_and_scope_limits: A fixed wordbook, its exact order and V, one anchor and the complete C table are required reader knowledge. Unknown words, code aliases, silent zero differences or dynamically inserted entries are outside the stated writer.
Source token punctuation and paragraph delimiters are whatever the predeclared projection actually preserves. No extra normalization or hidden boundary supplies a missing antecedent.
Visible output spaces delimit codewords. Their internal working-unit decomposition need not be interpreted for this theorem, but exact whole-group identity and boundaries remain assumptions.
Codeword lengths and shapes can vary arbitrarily under this necessary family. Surviving B>=4does not produce a physical codebook, explain word parts or pass any statistical/semantic condition.

V=1is valid with only residue0. An empty book with V=0is outside the channel. Empty or fewer-than-three-token paragraphs contribute no initial residue; fewer-than-four-token paragraphs contribute no interior residue.

The broader common modular arithmetic already appears in IDEA237. The word-rank source contract and marginal progression check are the specific reviewed addition; old1217/1268/001outcomes are unchanged.
access: Source-free proof and hand arithmetic only. No source/native payload, empirical output, image, program or fixture execution. Files authored in the original VManus proposal directory; no publication checkout or root experiment modified.
